isBasedOn.name: Governance as a Product (GaaP): A Reputation-Weighted Institutional Architecture for Autonomous AI Agent Governance

abstract: It retains full natural-language expressiveness and buys relia- bility through economic incentive alignment and reputation- weighted aggregation, accepting a bounded and auditable residual error rather than claiming its complete elimination. The concession is deliberate and is the paper’s central claim: institutional operability is worth a bounded residual.
